question: What does `<Comp v-model:title="t" />` expand to?
explanation: Named models use the prop name and an `update:<name>` event.

question: Which Vue 2 feature does `v-model:prop` replace?
explanation: Vue 3 removed `.sync`; `v-model:title` covers the same use case and a component can have several of them.

question: Why avoid `model.value.title = 'x'` when the model is an object?
options: It mutates the parent's object without emitting an update
explanation: Only assigning `model.value` emits. Deep mutation silently changes parent state, breaking one-way data flow.
